**Agent Name:** FileSurfer  
**Step Number:** 5  
**Reason for Mistake:** The error occurred because FileSurfer incorrectly analyzed the extracted text from the image. Specifically, the problems were miscounted: there were two problems involving forming mixed numbers (worth 20 points each) and two problems involving forming improper fractions (worth 15 points each), but FileSurfer incorrectly stated that there was only one mixed number problem and two improper fraction problems. This miscount led to an incorrect final score being calculated. The root cause was a failure to accurately perform text analysis on the extracted content, which is likely due to either OCR misinterpretation or inadequate parsing of the extracted text. This error skewed all subsequent calculations and resulted in the wrong final score.
